headline: ADNOC L&S Tanker Attacked During Transit in the Strait of Hormuz
summary: An ADNOC L&S vessel sustained an attack while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on November 17, 2026. The shipping unit confirmed the security incident along the critical maritime trade corridor.
why: ADNOC L&S is the logistics arm of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, operating critical maritime energy transport assets.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Attacks on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz raise supply disruption risks and shipping insurance premiums.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Escalating security threats in key oil chokepoints elevate risk premiums in crude markets.
